notes.title: Beholder: Conductor — Release Date Reveal
notes.content:
Beholder: Conductor will be leaving the station and launching April 23rd on Steam. In this spin-off in the Beholder series, you step into the role of a senior conductor on the legendary Determination Bringer train, tasked with monitoring passengers, enforcing strict regulations, and completing high-stakes Ministry assignments that could determine their future. 

[previewyoutube=xwIS1SPvQoA;full][/previewyoutube]
The train is preparing for a long and thrilling journey across the country. 
Your responsibilities include readying the compartments, welcoming the passengers, and enforcing order throughout the route. You will meet people from all corners of the nation. Hear their stories. And decide — who deserves to ride on, and who will be removed from the train.  

As your loyalty to the Ministry deepens, you will unlock access to secret missions that offer rewards and opportunities for promotion. But beware – the journey is filled with risks, including encounters with smugglers, bribery, and corruption. Your choices will shape the lives of passengers — and the course of history, leading to multiple endings. 

[b]Please review and comply with the Ministry’s directives: [/b]

[list]
[*] Monitor all passengers 
[*] Report their actions and file misconduct notices 
[*] Conduct baggage searches (preferably unnoticed) 
[*] Rise through the ranks… or come under investigation 
[/list]
Ticket price will be disclosed on departure day. New conductors will receive 10% off during the first 10 days after launch 

The Ministry relies on your loyalty:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2825530/Beholder_Conductor 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/alawar][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25109399/92832aabb467c3b70c6f9f9eef3cf5bf8bd7d88f.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Karate Survivor is out now!
notes.content:
Are you ready to unleash your inner martial arts master? Karate Survivor is live, ready to throw you into the gritty, fast-paced world of 80s street brawls! 

In this survivor-like roguelite, every corner of the city is your battleground. Fend off relentless thugs using fists, feet, and anything you can get your hands on – from mop handles to plastic flamingos! Your surroundings are part of your arsenal. Push over scaffolding, swing microwave doors, and turn the world into a weapon. 

[previewyoutube=WH_KjiLuvMg;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]What awaits you in Karate Survivor: [/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Improvised Combat:[/b] Use whatever you can get your hands on to dismantle your enemies. Even a toy hammer can be lethal! 
[*][b] Environmental Warfare: [/b]Manipulate the streets to your advantage. Push objects at enemies, bring down scaffolding, or slam them with a microwave door. 
[*] [b]Dynamic Combos: [/b]Mix and match dozens of attacks into unique six-move combos. Find the most devastating combos to suit your style. 
[*] [b]Progression and Mastery: [/b]Unlock and master techniques that stay with you across runs. Every fight brings you closer to martial arts mastery. 
[*] [b]Fast-paced Runs and Boss Battles: [/b]Face fierce bosses across gritty locations in epic, high-speed showdowns. 
[/list]
Also, we’ll be adding a new challenge mode as a New Game+ with increased difficulty in an upcoming post-release patch for those eager to test their skills. 

Stay tuned and grab Karate Survivor now with a 10% launch discount. Don’t forget to leave a review to support us!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3027930/Karate_Survivor/

notes.title: Technotopia is Now Available!
notes.content:
[b]Technotopia, a game developed by Yustas and published by Alawar, is now available on Windows and macOS![/b] The city of the future awaits, and it’s your time to take control. 

As the AI Iris, you are tasked with creating the perfect city in a world fractured by social and economic unrest. The metropolis teeters on the edge of chaos, and the balance between competing factions is fragile. Every decision you make will shape the fate of Technotopia – will you build a utopia, or let the city descend into turmoil? 

[previewyoutube=8ZPQsLAHWfg;full][/previewyoutube]

What awaits you in Technotopia: 

[list]
[*] 4 Faction-Driven Questlines: Capitalists, aristocrats, politicians, and common citizens all want control of the city. Navigate their conflicting agendas and choose your allies wisely – each storyline will alter the city’s future. 
[*] 100+ Unique Buildings: Construct skyscrapers, parks, residential zones, and industrial hubs. Every building you place will influence the balance of power, helping or hindering different factions. Strategically combine city blocks to maximize efficiency and unlock special bonuses. 
[*] 50+ Dynamic Events: From everyday mishaps to faction conflicts, every event in Technotopia is shaped by your choices, with consequences that ripple across the city. 
[*] Factions' Influence: Every decision shifts the delicate balance between the city’s ruling groups. Will you appease the elites, or side with the people? 
[*] City News & Criminal Activity: As crime rises, new challenges emerge, forcing you to make tough decisions. Stay informed through real-time news reports that reflect the impact of your actions on the city's order. 
[/list]
Get the game with a [b]10% launch[/b] discount and share your feedback on Technotopia – we’re excited to hear your thoughts! Join our Discord to stay up to date on the latest news. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2825110/Technotopia/

notes.title: Necroking is now available!
notes.content:
Necroking has officially emerged from the shadows and is now live on Windows and macOS! 

The world is crumbling under chaos. Cities are rotting and the living dare to stand in your way. But fear not, because you are the Necroking – master of the undead, wielder of dark magic, and bringer of doom. It’s time to raise your army and show the world what real power looks like! 

[previewyoutube=mZ1W5iGz0MU;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]What awaits you in Necroking:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Become the Death Monarch.[/b] Command over 30 unique undead minions and crush anyone who stands against you. 
[*] [b]Vast Skull Deckbuilding. [/b]Customize your deck, unlock powerful unites, and devastate your enemies. 
[*] [b]4 diverse biomes.[/b] Each with its own deadly challenges and unique bosses. 
[*] [b]King’s Secret. [/b]Unravel the mystery of the King as you journey through a dark, twisted story. 
[/list]
You can already play Necroking on Steam Deck using the trackpads, and we’re hard at work on adding full controller and Steam Deck support in upcoming updates. Stay tuned and join our [url=https://discord.gg/alawar]Discord[/url] server to keep up with all the news!

Get the game with a 10% launch discount and leave feedback on Necroking – we can’t wait to hear what you think: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2852980/Necroking/

notes.title: Beholder DLC Update
notes.content:
[b]The Ministry of Propaganda[/b] reminds you that you live in the greatest country in the world! 
[list]
[*] We don't need a border wall since we are securely protected from outside threats by the wisdom of our Leader! 
[*] We don't need community liaison offices since our government hears its citizens, even when they don't want this!
[/list]
[b]The Ministry of Gratification[/b] says:
[list]
[*]Now the countdown stops when you open your mailbox to read the latest press! 
[/list]
[b]The Ministry of Linguistics[/b] has made improvements:
[list]
[*]Translations into Polish, Chinese and Italian are even better!
[/list]
[b]The Ministry of Bug Fixes[/b] continues to exceed the plan:
[list]
[*] Fixed the animation of some characters;
[*] Fixed a bug where, when using the gamepad, players could collect information/evidence when the game was paused or when the in-game menu was open;
[*] Fixed a bug where, when using the gamepad, players could scale the game scene when the in-game menu was open;
[*] Fixed the discrepancy in Manishek's age in the main part and addition of "Blissful Sleep";
[*] Fixed the discrepancy in the end dates of the "Blissful Sleep" prequel and the start of the main game;
[*] Fixed a reduction in performance when receiving the mission "The government knows everything";
[*] Fixed a bug where the main character couldn't leave the apartment of tenants at the convergence of several circumstances;
[*] Fixed the lack of door opening/closing sounds.
[/list]

Employees of all Ministries are working overtime and don't need any time off or wage increases because they are united by a supreme objective - service to benefit the citizenry!
And how many denouncements have YOU already sent to the Ministry?!

notes.title: Beholder Update!
notes.content:
[b]The Ministry of Propaganda[/b] reports:

[b]The Minister of Agriculture[/b] has completed his trial period as prime minister and has taken his office officially since today.  Undoubtedly, staff policy of our Leader is blameless as all other things he has his wise hand in! 

The new [b]Cabinet of Ministers[/b] is doing all possible for the benefit of our citizens. Here are the first fruits of the cabinet's labors:
[olist]
[*][b]The Ministry of Innovations[/b] has enabled DualShock 4 and Xbox game controller support.
[*][b]The Ministry of Controls[/b] has added the ability to scale scenes by pressing Num+ and Num-.
[*][b]The Ministry of Linguistics[/b] has improved the Chinese (Simplified) and German translations.
[*]The state has given the Excellence in Service Award to the [b]Ministry of Error Correction[/b] for:
[list]
[*]Correcting the "Border Disruption" achievement error in Trainee mode;
[*]Correcting the "Solitary Man" achievement error in Trainee mode;
[*]Correcting the error that gave the player a negative balance when he or she did not complete the "Pick up the phone" quest; and
[*]Correcting the error that occasionally allowed Carl to pass through a closed door.
[/list]
[i]*Please note that [u]foreign spies[/u] introduced these errors to the game. The infiltrators are jealous of the peaceful, happy lives our citizens lead![/i]
